stem.text: The balanced equation for the reaction of X with an excess of acidified $\text{K}_2\text{Cr}_2\text{O}_7$ is shown.
Compound Y is the only organic product of the reaction.

A.alt: Displayed formula A: a central CH bonded to two CHO groups and to CH(OH)CH3.

B.alt: Displayed formula B: a four-carbon chain with three OH groups.

C.alt: Displayed formula C: a three-carbon chain with three OH groups (glycerol).

D.alt: Displayed formula D: a central CH bonded to three CHO groups.
